sloka: मुद्गराः कूटपाशाश्च दीप्ताश्चाशनयस्तथा ।निष्पेतुर्विविधास्तीक्ष्णा वाता इव युगक्षये ।। ६.१०१.४ ।।
transliteration: mudgarāḥ kūṭapāśāśca dīptāścāśanayastathā ।niṣpeturvividhāstīkṣṇā vātā iva yugakṣaye ।। 6.101.4 ।।

translations.english: Several kinds of sharp multitudes of weapons and flaming thunderbolts issued forth like gales at the time of universal destruction.
